seoTitle: Sunburst Chart Maker with Zoom into a Branch
metaDescription: Turn path and value rows into a sunburst of concentric rings. Zoom into one branch by typing its path. Free SVG with a table.
intro: Draws a hierarchy as rings: the first level in the inner ring, children outside it, arc length by value.
why:
A sunburst keeps the parent-child relationship visible while showing proportions. Instead of clicking a segment to zoom, you type the branch path, for example Asia/Japan, which also works with a keyboard and a screen reader.

Labels appear along an arc when they fit and radially in thin ring segments; small arcs keep a tooltip and a table row. Limit the rings if the outer levels become dust.
howTo: Optionally type a path in Zoom into to show only that branch.
Limit the number of rings if needed.

faq.a: Enter the branch path in the zoom box, using the same names as in your rows.

faq.q: Why is there a centre label?
faq.a: It shows the branch you are viewing and its total.

faq.q: Are values summed up the tree?
faq.a: Yes. A parent equals its children plus any own value.
Each top-level branch has a colour; deeper rings are lighter.
